- bul_unify_001: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through governed agentic systems architecture and multi-agent orchestration contracts.

- bul_unify_003: Strengthened production trust with audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows, supported by evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
- bul_unify_004: Accelerated the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks by standardizing managed workflow orchestration, replayable runtime design, and exit disposition governance.
- bul_unify_005: Delivered high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across cloud data infrastructure, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a scalable operating model.
